pages.text:
Splits water with FE: 1 mB of water makes 2 mB of Hydrogen and 1 mB of Oxygen, like the real thing.
- 1,200 FE per mB of water (600 per mB of hydrogen) at 400 FE/t. Energy upgrades cut that, but never below the floor: hydrogen must always cost more FE than any setup can get back by burning it.
- Water goes in through Input faces (the top by default). Hydrogen and Oxygen leave through their own faces (left and right by default) into Pressurized Conduits, Cylinders or Gas Cartridges.
- Takes Speed and Energy upgrades and a redstone setting.
